## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover what changed
- [ ] What users notice has its entry under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] The documentation of the change is in this pull request
- [ ] A significant decision has a record in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] New dependencies have licenses that ADR 0001 allows
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) and are signed off (`git commit -s`)
